authorization: User requested training and datasets from scratch; local compute only, no spending
scope: Synthetic structural appearance pretraining and synthetic structural-state estimation; not a replacement for full-schema real Model 1 or physical validation
stopping_rule: Six preregistered candidates per model, two seeds each; per-run validation early stopping. Report search plateau only if neither of the final two two-candidate rounds improves best validation score by the stated minimum; otherwise report budget_exhausted. Neither result proves a global optimum or physical-data necessity.
selection: Best mean validation macro-F1 for Model 1; lowest mean validation MAE for Model 2. Ensemble the two seeds of the selected candidate only.
calibration: Separate scene/scenario-disjoint calibration partition. 90% split-conformal sets for Model 1 using maximum true-label score across each scene; Model 2 simultaneous trajectory intervals using maximum absolute residual per scenario. No guarantee under OOD shift.
heldout_policy: Lock all trained checkpoints and model selection before calibration or test/OOD inference. Evaluate selected ensembles once. Never tune on test/OOD results.
